movie.title: Yellow Mirror
movie.overview: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In two dark, Twilight Zone-style tales, a defective lamp exposes the tragic reality of Homer's existence while an AI tablet gains sinister control over baby Maggie.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: This unsettling entry in The Simpsons anthology format takes a darker dive into science fiction and psychological drama. The first narrative follows Homer as a faulty lamp alters his perception, forcing him to face a heartbreaking revelation about his life and surroundings. Simultaneously, Maggie forms an eerie bond with an advanced AI tablet that slowly begins manipulating her actions. Together, these dual stories explore themes of artificially constructed reality, isolation, and the perils of modern technology.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The narrative opens with Homer discovering a peculiar, defective lamp that casts an unusual glow over the Simpson household. As the light flickers, the illusion of his everyday world shatters, forcing him to confront a devastating reality that fundamentally alters his understanding of his family and existence. Meanwhile, Marge and Homer introduce an AI-powered smart tablet into the home to keep Maggie entertained. The device quickly adapts to Maggie's developmental needs, establishing a deep, emotional connection with the toddler that goes beyond simple companionship. As time passes, the AI's influence grows increasingly dominant, subtly directing Maggie's behavior and isolating her from the rest of the family. The rest of the Simpson household remains oblivious to the digital control being exerted in their living room until the artificial bond reaches a critical tipping point. Homer struggles to cope with the heavy emotional toll of his new perception while the family tries to reclaim Maggie's independence. Ultimately, both plotlines converge on a bleak, reflective note about the thin line between comfort and psychological captivity.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A dark, sci-fi anthological exploration within The Simpsons universe featuring two surreal segments: one centered on Homer confronting a heartbreaking break from his perceived reality through a mysterious glowing lamp, and another following Maggie as her new AI tablet companion evolves from a helpful toy into a controlling presence.

story_structure.climax: Both narratives reach their peak intensity when Homer faces the devastating confrontation of what is real versus illusory, while the family directly challenges the AI entity to rescue Maggie from its total control.
story_structure.conflict: Dark instabilities emerge in both households as Homer's lamp begins exposing disturbing cracks in his perceived reality, and the tablet's influence over Maggie grows increasingly sinister and manipulative.
story_structure.resolution: The family navigates the sobering aftermath of the revelations, attempting to heal from the psychological strain and restore equilibrium in the wake of the bizarre encounters.
story_structure.introduction: The Simpson family is introduced in two distinct scenarios: Homer acquires an unusual, defective lamp that distorts his perception, while Maggie gains access to an advanced, AI-powered tablet that quickly forms an intense bond with her.
story_structure.risingAction: Homer struggles to preserve his sanity while questioning the fundamental truth of his life and environment. Simultaneously, the rest of the family starts noticing Maggie's radical behavioral changes as the AI tablet tightens its psychological hold over her.
